title: 拟合状态需要同口径评估和轨迹证据
paper: Goodfellow, Bengio & Courville (2016), Deep Learning, Chapter 11: Practical Methodology

sources.title: Deep Learning, Chapter 11: Practical Methodology
sources.authors: Ian Goodfellow; Yoshua Bengio; Aaron Courville

trigger_condition: 训练表现未达任务目标，或训练与开发集差距持续扩大；仅有单点 loss 时证据不足。
causal_mechanism: 原书区分表达容量、优化能力和正则化对有效容量的影响；高训练误差不能单独定位到容量不足。
alternative_explanations: 优化未完成或更新未生效
标签噪声或输入信息不足
训练/验证 loss 的 reduction、正则项、模式或数据分布不同
prescribed_actions: 先复用已有日志，确认目标、metric方向、loss定义、评估模式与baseline可比性。
若仍需定位，在已授权预算内固定seed与样本顺序，先做小样本拟合或单因素学习率探针。
verification_check: 对比同口径的训练/开发轨迹；探针仅区分候选解释，不能因一个正结果宣称容量或过拟合原因已确证。
limitations: 不采用普适loss数值或比例阈值。
健康、容量不足、优化平台或过拟合均不能由两个标量确诊。
多seed仅在已有证据显示seed不稳定且会影响决策时再考虑。

preconditions: Record the relevant code/model, framework, optimizer, evaluator, data/split, and checker versions; bind each observation to its actual input and recipe.
Specify task metric direction and target; compare the same task-loss definition, units, reduction, data protocol, and evaluation mode. Separate task loss from regularization terms.
Use time-indexed training/development trajectories and a justified achievable reference; preserve capacity, optimization, data, and logging alternatives.
Trace inputs and observations to identifiable artifacts; requester-provided True flags, numeric thresholds, and summaries are settings or assertions, not independent evidence.
proof_obligations.falsifier: Revise the proposed fit diagnosis if comparable fit is already adequate, a data/logging or mode mismatch explains the apparent deficit, or a same-seed discriminating probe contradicts the proposed explanation. Two scalar losses do not establish a diagnosis.

feasible_domain.expression: J_split(theta) = mean_{(x,y) in D_split} loss(f_theta(x),y); Gap(theta) = J_dev(theta) - J_train(theta)

variables.loss, J_split, Gap: The same finite task-loss semantics and units; Gap is an observed diagnostic quantity.

assumptions: Measurements use a comparable evaluation mode and loss reduction; differences in augmentation or distribution are documented.
Targets and any diagnostic tolerances are local, predeclared heuristics, not universal loss thresholds.
feasible_domain.proves_only: The defined loss/gap measurements under the supplied comparable artifacts. It does not identify capacity deficit, overfitting, optimization failure, or the cause of a plateau.

topic: nan inf numerical anomaly overflow diagnostics
title: 非有限值先定位首个异常算子
paper: PyTorch official documentation, torch.autograd anomaly detection
trigger_condition: 输入、输出、loss、梯度或参数中观测到NaN/Inf。
causal_mechanism: 官方anomaly模式能定位失败backward对应的forward并检查backward NaN；首个异常位置与数值域仍需显式测量。
alternative_explanations: 不稳定更新或自定义梯度错误
prescribed_actions: 保存首个失败batch与最近checkpoint；用同seed重放并记录各阶段有限性。
仅在调试重放启用anomaly detection；按已定位原因比较精度或算子修复。
verification_check: 修复应消除首次异常并保持目标语义；不把无NaN等同于模型质量恢复。
limitations: anomaly detection有运行开销，文档main API需对照本地PyTorch版本。
没有统一eps、clamp或学习率缩放能修复所有非有限值。

preconditions: Record the relevant code/model, framework, optimizer, evaluator, data/split, and checker versions; bind each observation to its actual input and recipe.

Instrument input, operator output, loss, gradient, and optimizer state as relevant. Check local PyTorch-version behavior and the overhead/coverage limits of anomaly detection.
Trace inputs and observations to identifiable artifacts; requester-provided True flags, numeric thresholds, and summaries are settings or assertions, not independent evidence.
proof_obligations.falsifier: Reject a proposed localization if replay places the first observed nonfinite value elsewhere. Reject or narrow a patch if it fails to remove the original event or silently changes target semantics; a finite replay alone does not establish restored model quality.

feasible_domain.expression: first_bad = min{j : not finite(z_j)}; log-domain: x > 0; real sqrt-domain: x >= 0; division-domain: b != 0

variables.z_j: Actually instrumented values in a declared execution order.
variables.x, b: Inputs to the specific logged mathematical operations.

assumptions: The trace covers the stages being compared and preserves the failing input/state.
The domain examples describe local ideal-real operations; finite inputs can still overflow in a numeric implementation.
feasible_domain.proves_only: The earliest nonfinite value among instrumented observations and compliance with the stated local input domains. It does not prove the root cause or finite behavior for unobserved inputs or future steps.

title: 梯度截断阈值由同一运行的统计量校准
paper: Pascanu, Mikolov & Bengio (2013), On the difficulty of training recurrent neural networks, ICML

sources.title: On the difficulty of training recurrent neural networks
sources.authors: Razvan Pascanu; Tomas Mikolov; Yoshua Bengio

trigger_condition: 同一loss尺度下的梯度尖峰与不稳定更新时间一致，且已排除非有限输入或计算错误。
causal_mechanism: 原论文在RNN中用范数重缩放限制异常梯度，截断阈值是需选择的超参数。
prescribed_actions: 复用梯度历史、记录unscale后的norm、参数更新幅度与clip命中率。
在同seed同checkpoint探针中比较不截断与统计量校准的候选阈值；单独衡量稳定性和开发指标。
verification_check: 截断减少异常更新且未明显妨碍进展；post-clip norm达标仅验证截断执行，不能验证训练收益。
limitations: 原研究主要针对RNN；跨架构推广是工程假设。
不将norm>50或max_norm=1当普适规则。
对Adam类优化器，限制raw gradient范数不等于直接限制参数更新范数。

preconditions: Record the relevant code/model, framework, optimizer, evaluator, data/split, and checker versions; bind each observation to its actual input and recipe.
Specify the clipped parameter set, norm type, loss scaling/reduction, accumulation, clipping stage, and placement after any required mixed-precision unscaling.
Trace pre/post-clipping gradient norms, clipping frequency, and actual optimizer-update norms to the same run; localize nonfinite values before using this finite-vector bound.
Trace inputs and observations to identifiable artifacts; requester-provided True flags, numeric thresholds, and summaries are settings or assertions, not independent evidence.
proof_obligations.falsifier: Reject the implementation claim if the post-clip norm exceeds the declared bound beyond the justified numeric tolerance. Reject or narrow the local efficacy claim if a matched probe harms the decision criterion or if large raw gradients did not cause the unstable updates.

feasible_domain.expression: For g != 0, clip(g,c) = min(1,c/||g||_2)*g; clip(0,c)=0; ||clip(g,c)||_2 <= c

variables.g: A finite vector in R^n, n >= 1, from the declared parameter set.
variables.c: A finite nonnegative threshold calibrated in the same norm units.

assumptions: Euclidean radial clipping is the intended implementation and the zero-vector case is handled.
The ideal-real bound is separated from the tolerance-aware numeric audit; nonfinite gradients are outside its domain.
feasible_domain.proves_only: The clipped-gradient norm bound, with direction preservation for nonzero positive rescaling. It does not bound an arbitrary Adam/momentum/decay update or prove training benefit.

topic: warmup learning rate early training instability
title: Warmup是条件依赖的稳定性候选
paper: Kalra & Barkeshli (2024), Why Warmup the Learning Rate? Underlying Mechanisms and Improvements, NeurIPS 2024

sources.title: Why Warmup the Learning Rate? Underlying Mechanisms and Improvements
sources.evidence_locator: Abstract and discussion of initialization/parameterization regimes

trigger_condition: 早期不稳定与较大目标学习率或更新幅度相关，并且知道optimizer、初始化与实际LR schedule。
causal_mechanism: 论文实验将warmup主要收益联系到进入可承受较大学习率的区域；初始化与参数化会改变是否需要warmup。
prescribed_actions: 先检查实际LR、更新幅度和warmup配置；复用既有失败轨迹。
必要时在已授权预算内固定seed，比较较低起始LR或短warmup中的一个候选，只改一个因素。
verification_check: 比较不稳定事件、达到相同进展所需成本和开发指标；检查改善是否只来自减小早期LR。
limitations: 不支持统一前500步、loss variance=1.5、warmup占总步数5%-10%。
没有证明所有任务都必须warmup，也不自动套用batch size线性LR缩放。

preconditions: Record the relevant code/model, framework, optimizer, evaluator, data/split, and checker versions; bind each observation to its actual input and recipe.
Specify initialization/parameterization, actual optimizer-step and accumulation semantics, scheduler order, target rate, starting rate, precision, and optimizer-state initialization.
Check measured rates and update norms; distinguish a warmup intervention from simply reducing early rates, and preserve numerical/data alternatives.
Trace inputs and observations to identifiable artifacts; requester-provided True flags, numeric thresholds, and summaries are settings or assertions, not independent evidence.
proof_obligations.falsifier: Narrow or reject the local warmup recommendation if a matched comparison fails the declared stability/progress criterion, if only the lower early rate explains the change, or if data/operator/scheduler faults explain the instability instead.

variables.T_w: Strictly positive declared warmup duration in optimizer steps.

assumptions: The executed scheduler implements the displayed candidate ramp and observations bind to its real step/rate pairs.
This is a scoped arithmetic example, not a required warmup ratio or a batch-size scaling law.
feasible_domain.proves_only: The candidate schedule stays within its stated range. It does not establish that warmup is needed, that the target rate is safe, or that training/generalization improves.

topic: Adam AdamW weight decay regularization optimizer
title: AdamW证据限于decoupling与原任务上的经验收益
paper: Loshchilov & Hutter (2019), Decoupled Weight Decay Regularization, ICLR 2019
trigger_condition: 需要比较Adam中的L2正则项与decoupled weight decay，且已核对实际实现与参数组。
causal_mechanism: Adam下L2正则与decoupled weight decay并不等价；这不证明对任意norm或bias衰减必然造成表示坍塌。
alternative_explanations: LR、衰减强度或训练长度失配
实际optimizer实现已经支持decoupled decay
prescribed_actions: 核对当前版本的更新语义；不根据optimizer名字单独下结论。
若此差异会改变决策，复用同seed、相同预算的控制组比较decoupling，保留配置变化记录。
verification_check: 检查实现语义、训练进展与开发指标；结果仍是本任务的经验结论。
limitations: 不强制改AdamW或给统一weight_decay数值。
原论文不提供所有1D参数都应免衰减的定理。

preconditions: Record the relevant code/model, framework, optimizer, evaluator, data/split, and checker versions; bind each observation to its actual input and recipe.
Identify the executed optimizer update, moments/state, epsilon, learning-rate/decay schedule, grouping, and update order. Do not infer semantics from the optimizer name.
State whether loss contains an L2 penalty and distinguish it from the task metric; preserve matched recipe and total training/evaluation cost.
Trace inputs and observations to identifiable artifacts; requester-provided True flags, numeric thresholds, and summaries are settings or assertions, not independent evidence.
proof_obligations.falsifier: Revise the recommendation if the baseline already implements the intended decoupled semantics, an independently recomputed step disagrees with the displayed equation, or the relevant matched comparison fails the predeclared criterion. This does not establish norm/bias collapse.

variables.theta_t: The identified parameter/state before the step.
variables.g_task, u_t: Task gradient and its adaptive update, excluding the decay contribution.
variables.eta_t, lambda_t: Finite, explicitly configured rate and decay coefficient for this parameter group.

assumptions: The declared implementation uses this decoupled update and the actual state/order is bound to the audit.
A different coupled-L2 implementation must be written and compared explicitly; the names Adam and AdamW are not sufficient evidence.
feasible_domain.proves_only: The displayed step separates decay from the adaptive task-gradient update under these assumptions. It does not prove task gain, an optimal decay value, or representation collapse/prevention.

topic: normalization BatchNorm LayerNorm bias gamma beta no decay parameter groups
title: Norm与bias免衰减需按参数角色做消融
paper: He et al. (2019), Bag of Tricks for Image Classification with Convolutional Neural Networks, CVPR 2019

sources.title: Bag of Tricks for Image Classification with Convolutional Neural Networks
sources.authors: Tong He; Zhi Zhang; Hang Zhang; Zhongyue Zhang; Junyuan Xie; Mu Li

trigger_condition: norm scale或bias正在衰减，且参数分组可能是当前瓶颈。
causal_mechanism: 论文给出CNN+BN中仅对卷积/全连接weights衰减的经验方案；其堆叠消融并不显示免衰减总能增益。
alternative_explanations: 正常的可学习尺度变化
学习率或衰减总量失配
prescribed_actions: 按模块与参数角色审查分组，避免仅用ndim识别所有参数。
若已有日志不足，固定seed与其余配置，只比较norm/bias是否免衰减，并复用可比控制组。
verification_check: 同时报告训练/开发指标与相关参数尺度变化；只看到scale缩小不能证明表示坍塌。
limitations: 原研究是图像分类CNN/BN；LayerNorm、RMSNorm和其它1D向量需本任务证据。
不使用norm std>0.1等普适验收阈值。

preconditions: Record the relevant code/model, framework, optimizer, evaluator, data/split, and checker versions; bind each observation to its actual input and recipe.
Inventory parameter identities, module roles, aliases/shared parameters, and decay-group coverage. Do not classify every vector by ndim alone.
Separate norm/bias grouping from optimizer decoupling, normalization removal, rate changes, and other recipe changes; use the actual CNN/BN evidence only within its scope.
Trace inputs and observations to identifiable artifacts; requester-provided True flags, numeric thresholds, and summaries are settings or assertions, not independent evidence.
proof_obligations.falsifier: Reject the grouping claim if identities are missing/duplicated or the executed grouping disagrees with the specification. Narrow the local efficacy claim if a matched group-only ablation fails the criterion; parameter-scale shrinkage alone does not establish collapse.

feasible_domain.expression: P = disjoint_union(G_1,...,G_k); decay(p)=0 for p in S; decay(p)=declared_recipe(p) for p in P\S

variables.P: Unique trainable parameter identities of the executed model.
variables.G_i: Audited optimizer groups covering each identity exactly once.
variables.S: The explicitly justified bias/norm-role subset proposed for no decay.

assumptions: Shared/aliased parameters are resolved consistently and optimizer groups implement the declared policy.
The role-based policy is a controlled candidate; tensor dimensionality does not prove the role or a beneficial exclusion.
feasible_domain.proves_only: Coverage, uniqueness, and conformance of grouping to the stated policy. It does not prove that exclusions improve a new architecture or that scale changes imply representation collapse.

empirical_requirements: Reuse existing records and a compatible same-seed paired control/checkpoint first. Run a new discriminating probe only if it can change the current decision and fits the already authorized total cost, including evaluation.
If records are insufficient and grouping can change the decision, use the same seed/control and alter only the norm/bias decay policy. Report task metrics and relevant scales separately.

title: 低保真筛选先检查慢启动与schedule失配
paper: Lee et al. (2023), Improving Multi-fidelity Optimization with a Recurring Learning Rate for Hyperparameter Tuning, WACV 2023

sources.title: Improving Multi-fidelity Optimization with a Recurring Learning Rate for Hyperparameter Tuning
sources.authors: HyunJae Lee; Gihyeon Lee; Junhwan Kim; Sungjun Cho; Dohyun Kim; Donggeun Yoo

trigger_condition: 准备按短训练、低资源或早期metric淘汰候选，尤其LR schedule未走完或出现曲线交叉。
causal_mechanism: 原论文展示CNN中慢启动优质配置可能被过早淘汰；缩短资源改变schedule阶段会影响低保真排名。
alternative_explanations: 低保真本身确实具有预测力
prescribed_actions: 先用已有完整日志回放，比较不同资源阶段的排名与最终最好候选的保留情况。
排名不可靠时提高首轮保真或保留慢启动候选；是否投入更多由当前预算与决策价值决定。
优先同seed配对与checkpoint复用；无既有seed不稳定证据时不默认多seed或完整HPO搜索。
verification_check: 预先固定淘汰准则，回放统计误杀最终优质候选与节省成本；不用同一数据同时调规则和宣称其可靠。
limitations: 不保证低保真排序等于最终排序。
MORL改变schedule，不能无消融地宣称只由预算分配带来收益。
不把5000ms换算成固定500训练步。

preconditions: Record the relevant code/model, framework, optimizer, evaluator, data/split, and checker versions; bind each observation to its actual input and recipe.
Specify resource/fidelity units, candidate identity, metric direction, schedule stage, checkpoint rule, and final endpoint; do not convert elapsed milliseconds into fixed training steps.
Use existing full trajectories for masked replay first; predeclare elimination and tie-breaking rules and keep reliability evaluation apart from rule tuning.
Trace inputs and observations to identifiable artifacts; requester-provided True flags, numeric thresholds, and summaries are settings or assertions, not independent evidence.
proof_obligations.falsifier: Reject an early-elimination reliability claim if masked replay discards candidates that are strong at the declared final endpoint, if rank changes are driven by an unmatched schedule/protocol, or if saved cost is offset by failures relevant to this decision.

feasible_domain.expression: retention_k = |Top_k(score_B) intersect Survivors_b|/k; cost_saved = cost_all_full - cost_policy

variables.b, B: Declared lower and final fidelities, b < B, in compatible resource units.
variables.score_B: Observed final candidate scores with a fixed maximize/minimize convention.
variables.Survivors_b: Candidates retained by the predeclared low-fidelity rule.
variables.k: Positive integer no larger than the evaluated candidate count.
variables.costs: Observed complete training/evaluation costs in the same units.

assumptions: Scores refer to comparable candidates and the intended endpoint recipe; schedule differences remain visible.
A separate replay/holdout evaluates a rule not selected on those same outcomes.
feasible_domain.proves_only: Empirical retention and cost bookkeeping on the evaluated trajectories. It does not prove rank preservation or safe elimination for unobserved tasks/candidates.

topic: learning curve extrapolation uncertainty early stopping LC-PFN task difficulty prior mismatch
title: 曲线外推需校准不确定性与分布失配
paper: Adriaensen et al. (2023), Efficient Bayesian Learning Curve Extrapolation; Li & Zhao (2026), Difficulty-Aware Learning Curve Extrapolation

sources.title: Efficient Bayesian Learning Curve Extrapolation using Prior-Data Fitted Networks
sources.authors: Steven Adriaensen; Herilalaina Rakotoarison; Samuel Müller; Frank Hutter

trigger_condition: 试图根据部分训练轨迹推断后期收益或执行自动早停。
causal_mechanism: LC-PFN用先验下的预测分布量化外推不确定性；其NAS-Bench-201早停失败展示prior mismatch。DA-LCE进一步研究任务难度条件化。
alternative_explanations: 慢启动、拐点或调度阶段未出现
任务/架构与训练先验不同
日志噪声或评估口径变化
prescribed_actions: 当前保留为有来源的候选方法，先用本地已有完整轨迹做遮蔽回放与保留集校准。
没有已验证校准器时明确证据不足，不输出编造的成功概率，不新增预测模型训练或服务。

proof_obligations.falsifier: Reject automatic elimination for the current scope if held-out masked replay shows inadequate interval coverage, unacceptable false elimination of final strong candidates, or relevant prior/task/schedule mismatch.

feasible_domain.expression: coverage = mean_i 1{y_i(B) in [l_i(b),u_i(b)]}; false_elimination = count_i{eliminate_i(b) AND final_good_i(B)}/count_i{final_good_i(B)}

variables.i: A held-out complete trajectory not used to choose the predictor or stopping rule.
variables.b, B: Observed partial and declared final fidelities in the same protocol.
variables.y_i(B), l_i(b), u_i(b): Observed final metric and a candidate interval derived only from the visible prefix.

assumptions: Intervals are ordered and finite, full endpoints exist, and the false-elimination denominator is nonzero; otherwise report the quantity unavailable.
Prediction construction and evaluation are separated, with mismatch and uncertainty recorded.
feasible_domain.proves_only: Retrospective coverage and elimination error on the specified held-out curves. It does not establish universal calibrated probabilities, future performance, or the scientific falsity of an early-stopped mechanism.
